create_quat_from_coeffs: create a quaternion from simulator backend coefficients in [b, c, d, a] format
convert_quat_to_angle_axis: convert a quaternion to angle axis format returning the rotation angle and axis
create_quat_from_two_vectors: create a quaternion that rotates one vector onto another vector
rotate_vector_by_quat: rotate a 3D vector by a quaternion using the q v q inverse formula
compute_angle_between_quats: compute the angular distance in radians between two magnum quaternions
